title: onboard-zenovia-20b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Onboard Zenovia-20B v1.0 to the model registry with performance profiles, metadata, and automated changelog entry. Motivation: Zenovia provides a strong accuracy/cost tradeoff for multi-turn chat workloads; adding it to the registry enables customers to evaluate it with Redwood's serving runtime and get automated recommendations (quantization/profile) for Dedicated/Private deployments. What this PR does: 1) Adds canonical metadata for zenovia-20b v1.0 (tokenizer, architecture, supported backends, recommended sequence lengths). 2) Adds perf_profiles for A100/H100/T4 and a lightweight throughput/latency summary used by the console and rollout heuristics. 3) Adds quantization guidance (fp16/q4_q8 variants) and recommended batch sizes for typical latency SLOs. 4) Adds tokenizer/component sanity tests and a small integration harness used by the onboarding CI job. 5) Extends changelog automation so the model appears in generated release notes (automated yaml -> markdown entry). 6) Docs: adds registry index entry and example config snippet for Dedicated. Checklist: - [x] metadata schema validated against registry v2 schema - [x] perf profiles generated from calibration runs (A100/H100/T4) - [x] automated changelog generator updated + test - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] reviewed and signed off by perf and platform leads Notable implementation details: - metadata: models/zenovia/metadata.json includes tokenizer fingerprint, model_size="20B", kv_cache=true, supported_backends=["cuda","rocm","cpu"], recommended_max_seq=4096. - perf_profiles: generated by perf-lab harness; includes p50/p95 latencies and tokens/sec for common batch/seq configs. Profiles include memory headroom hints used by the private installer. - changelog automation: changelog-generator now picks up models/*/metadata.json entries with field release_note and outputs a formatted entry. This PR includes a test dataset for the generator to ensure the Zenovia entry renders correctly. Rollout plan: merge to main -> nightly registry build will publish metadata to staging registry -> scheduled smoke on Dedicated staging pools -> promote to hosted catalog after 48h if no regressions. Related: ENG-4321 (model onboarding infra), MREG-1287 (perf profiling infra).
